allow_instructions: Read-only git commands (status, diff, log) can run without asking.
Listing or reading files in the workspace can run without asking.
Running Godot headless smoke tests for this project can run without asking.
Running project test scripts under tools/ and tests/ can run without asking.
block_instructions: Any command that deletes files must ask for approval.
Any command that modifies .env or git config must ask for approval.
Any global install (npm install -g, pip install --user) must ask for approval.
